strings.en: Keep things smart, yeah?
What will be, will be.
Tough luck.
You're finished!
Give it up.
You'd best give up.
I'll end this quickly, that's how it is.
I don't intend to drag this out...!
So you stand before me.
I won't hold back.
You'll be my opponent, then.
You noticed too late.
I've already got you in my sights.
Regret it in the next world.
Careless... You're in range...!
Take this!
Hold still. Until it hits, that is.
You're in my sights... Say your prayers.
There...!
I won't miss!
Mine!
This one's going to hit!
I can handle close combat too...!
Come close and I'll cut you down!
I'll cut you down!
Perfect position...!
You're in my sights!
Let's go, Soulgain!
It was our machine to begin with./　Of course I can handle it.
As I thought, this thing suits me well.
So-Des, don't think this'll stay a game.
He's not as easy an opponent as you think.
The weakest dogs bark the loudest, that's how it is.
I can't say I don't understand that obsession.
Jua-Mu, I'll end your fight right here.
Here I come, Al-Van Ranks.
Al-Van, I'm taking you down...!
Fu-Ruu, let me inside your guard and you lose.
So that Raftclans is going to be a wall...!
Only ever announcing death can't be much fun, can it?
Gu-Landon, I don't care about your cherished dream!
There's no future where you become/　emperor of the Fury!
What a bizarre bunch.
If you come at me, I'll just knock you back.
Your business won't succeed.
Laugh while you still can, that's how it is.
A manager who works in the field, huh./　Saves me the trouble.
I have no business with you. Out of the way!
I don't have time to deal with small fry!
That scythe or my strike.../　Shall we see which is faster?!
You can't beat me, Vort Nicholaus!
Don't worry, I'll send Herluga/　to the same place soon enough.
For a mere mad scientist,/　you sure came up with something audacious.
The Cross Gate is too much for you./　Hand it over already.
Clown... I'll twist that face of yours.
Keep the joke to that face of yours.
To think even Zovorg machines are being controlled.
I'll make sure you can never possess anything again.
No need to hold back at all.
It was more or less a puppet to begin with.
The Crystal Dragon, huh. I'll smash it.
I'll take your head, Crystal Dragoon.
Quite the face on that one, that's how it is.
Here I come, Skull Knight.
You won't get off with just broken bones,/　and that's that.
XN-L, so you were drawn here too.
You won't go to any other world. Disappear here!
A Zovorg machine. Nothing new.
Things like that are no match for me anymore.
Its guard is weak up close, I'd wager.
More of a challenge than the other small fry, at least.
They just don't know when to quit, that's how it is.
Golaikunru... You're uninvited guests too.
I have no interest in a spineless world./　But letting things go their way gets on my nerves.
I won't let you get to those two units.
If it's a Commander unit, it should be some challenge.
I'll pierce your fists and your armor all at once.
A battleship is just a target, that's how it is.
Seems this one's different/　from the Zovorg units so far.
I won't let some new face do as it pleases.
I have no business with the Fury's small fry.
Leave that Thick Cylinder to me.
I'll clear out the annoying small fry first!
I'll take down that Big Shoulder.
A White Horn, huh. I'll pierce it, armor and all.
I'll snap that horn off.
A Thorn, huh. A worthy opponent.
I won't give you a chance to pull any strange tricks.
To think I have to tuck my tail and fall back...!
I won't let Gadisword do as they please.
I won't show you any mercy, Gadisword.
Let's hope it's not all show.
I won't be outmatched, that's how it is.
Seems it's in a different league/　from the Gadisword small fry.
This world sure attracts its share of monsters.
I have no intention of letting/　the ghosts do as they please.
Vanish, Lamaris.
I can't waste time on mere Lamaris.
Even if the ghosts Combine, what I do is the same.
I'll take you apart, Lamaris Kaana.
Fused or not, I'm still erasing you.
Hmph, it's easier to aim now.
Get blown away, Lamaris Ida!
You've become even less human, Ares Geist.
If it saves me extra trouble, that's fine by me.
Are you satisfied with being used/　to the very end, Duban?
You're persistent...! Get off me!
Out of my way!
Time to start over.
I've figured out your tricks.
I'm the type who has to hit back.
You're not getting away!
Did you think you'd get away unharmed/　after attacking me?
If you're planning to run, it's too late.
I can't let you leave unscathed.
Ngh! Careless of me!
Damn it, is this the end?!
Uwaaaaaah!!
There's still a chance to turn this around...!
Ngh! What's going on?!
I haven't hit my limit yet.../　I'll fight as long as I can move!
Holding up better than I expected.../　Still, the odds are against me.
Ugh! I can't back down here!
Move faster than him... That's all there is to it...!
I'm not handing over this life of mine...!
Hold together, Gespenst Haken!
So you've shown some grit, Jua-Mu...!
You're far from finishing me, Jua-Mu!
You failed to finish me, Karo-Ran...!
You're the one who'll fall into this Voda darkness,/　Gu-Landon!
Reggiane, no matter how hard you defend...!
Ngh! That power is only borrowed, that's how it is!
Did you think it was over, Debudedabide...?
Just you wait, Skull Knight.../　I'll smash that body of yours to pieces!
XN-L, I won't kick the bucket that easily!
A Zovorg unit did this much... I got careless.
Go ahead and rest on your machine's specs...!
The Raftclans' sword strokes.../　Once I've read those, it's over!
Ngh! Damn you, Lamaris Ida...!
I can still move. Too bad for you.
You'll pay dearly for this!
Tch, that one cut deep.
Ngh, careless of me!
I see, so that's your move...!
Surely you don't think you've cornered me?
You can go toe to toe/　with the Gespenst Haken...!
I've no wish to play along with his amusements...!
I see. So that's your resolve...!
Falling behind a Raftclans...!
Al-Van... You won't let me read you that easily!
As long as we're here, you'll never be emperor...!
You're the one better suited to mercenary work...!
I won't let you push me over, Vort!
You're sloppy at the finish, Reggiane!
I have to pry him away from the Cross Gate, fast...!
A mere puppet, persistent to the end...!
You've done it now, Debudedabide...!
For all his looks, he's got some surprising tricks...!
Tch, damn you, Skull Knight!
Don't think I'll quietly accept destruction, XN-L!
So that's a high-performance unit's raw strength...!
With fire that heavy, the ship's position is obvious...!
Fury grunts...!
A cut above the Zovorg, then...!
Tch, Thorn got the better of me.
A contest of strength with a Kaana Type isn't wise...!
I've had my fill of spooks already...!
Hmph, has a ghost come to collect the dead?!
It didn't pierce the armor... No problem.
It only grazed the armor.
Come back when you're ready.
Hmph. It only rattled my machine.
Tch. To think I couldn't fully dodge it.
You can barely keep up with me, it seems.
Is that all? What a letdown.
You can't even slow me down.
Get serious, or you'll never take my life, So-Des.
Too shallow, Jua-Mu.
You've got the tenacity to hang on, at least.
I'll grant you that was well done, Al-Van.
Too soft, Fu-Ruu.
Weren't you supposed to be better than us,/　Karo-Ran?
Gu-Landon, who knew you had any mercy?
Don't let me down, Gomoudokka.
I thought you had more backbone than that, Vort.
Reggiane, you can't even slow me down.
That's all, with the Cross Gate's power?
Tch, to take a hit from a mere puppet.
Your cheap sorcery won't finish me.
Is that the best you've got, Crystal Dragoon?
No need to hold back, Skull Knight.
XN-L, I've no interest in hearing your sermon.
Small fry like that are no match for me, is all.
I can't beat this one while worrying about the others.
With a machine that grandiose,/　I expected more.
Even with that machine, you barely land a hit. Boring.
I've mostly got your moves figured out.
So the Fury have some skilled fighters too.
Surely you're not holding back, Thorn.
Gadisword's skill is passable, I suppose.
Rather familiar, for a mere ghost.
As expected, this one's worse than the other Lamaris.
Did you think I couldn't handle that, Ares Geist?
Hah! Too soft!
Don't think it'll be that easy.
I won't let you hit me!
Come back and try again. If there's a next time.
I've no intention of indulging your amusements.
You're not even worth talking about, Jua-Mu.
Did you think Drive could close the gap between us?
Don't think I'm easy to take, Al-Van.
Karo-Ran, I'm not handing you my life.
What a sorry state, Gu-Landon.
Hmph... A harsh way to attack.
You can't pin me down, Gomoudokka.
Just swinging a scythe around won't cut it.
Do you believe the Cross Gate will bring you victory?
I won't meet the same fate as that machine.
Heh... You're laughable, all right, Debudedabide.
All bluster, Crystal Dragoon.
Only your mouth has any momentum, Skull Knight.
And they call that a Kashin warship...
Zovorg machines, at this point...
So you've set your sights on me.
Barrages don't work on me.
Stop struggling, Gadisword.
Monster... I won't let you hit me.
I won't get caught by the likes of a Lamaris.
All that extra power, and you still can't hit me?
Our contest of strength will have to wait, Ares Geist.
What's wrong? Is that all?
Evaded...!
Can't you even grasp your own limits?
Type Haken, good response.
Of course I'd take to this thing naturally.
Is your sword just for show, Fu-Ruu?
Looks like you couldn't reach me, Reggiane.
This is no place for you, Fury grunt.
I'd heard Thorn was a tough one.
That Lamaris doesn't seem to see very well.
Too bad!
Like that'll work on me!
Useless!
Not enough force!
How could I slip up like this...!
Hmph. Couldn't do a thing, could you?
Careless...!
Slipped into my blind spot...!
Quick to run, aren't you...!
Not at this range, then.
Take this too!
I'll back you up... You won't refuse.
Take this as well!
I'll join in on this.
Didn't think I'd show up?!
No reason not to follow up!
Arieil, I'll lend you a hand.
Alchemie, leave the rest to me.
Too soft, Alchemie.
Out of the way, Touya Shiun.
Calvina, I'll lend you a hand.
Akimi Akatsuki, watch from there.
Stay back, Akemi Akatsuki.
Zovorg soldiers are softer than I thought.
I'm taking this one, Sieg Altolied.
Too naive, Sally Emil.
That's not like you, Haken.
That prey is mine, Haken.
You missed, Al-Van Ranks.
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
I won't let you have your way!
Don't make me waste my time!
Out of my way, Arieil!
Fall back, Touya Shiun!
You'll owe me for this one, Calvina!
Sieg Altolied, you left an opening!
Sally Emil, you're far too careless!
I can't abandon Haken!
Al-Van Ranks, did you lose your Focus?!
Soul Saber, fall back!
Pull the Super Soul Saber back!
You owe me one, 17.
The more I take with me, the better.
The weak always flock together...!
Your luck ran out!
I never miss an opening. That's a fact!
With this... you're mine!
This one's for good measure!
Matrix Missiles, launch!
Twin Linear Cannons, fire!!
Twin Linear Cannons... take this!
Go down!!
Pierce through!
I've got my aim!
You're taking this hit!
Target in sight!
Position and timing are perfect!
All locks released!
Aim set!
Go!
If this hits, you'll pay dearly...!
Target locked!
Be blown away!!
Halberd Launcher, shoot!
Halberd Launcher, fire!
Locks released...!
Go, Swordbreakers!
Run them down, Swordbreakers!
Now, go!
Blue Dragon Scale!
Take this! Blue Dragon Scale!
Genbu Bullet!
Pierce through!
Against this Genbu Bullet...!
Nothing stands unbroken!!
Hyah!
Byakko Bite! Hyaaah!
Hyaaah!!
Go! Byakko Bite!
Touch this edge... and you'll be cut!
Suzaku Dance... Can you read it?!
Haaah!!
Take this! Suzaku Dance!!
Limiter release!
Soulgain, full drive!
Hah!
Raaaaagh!!
Code Kirin!
This blow will finish it!!
Diiiyah!!
Vanish. From this world.
Blazer Knives!
Take this! Tidal Claws!
Seismic Slicer! Cut them down!
The raging gale will tear you apart...!
Storm Edge!
Limiter released, full drive!
Diiiiyah!!
Finishing blow!
That's the Radiant Blade for you.
Boost Hammer! Shatter!
Boost Hammer! Smash to pieces!
Graviton Launcher, go!
Graviton Launcher, fire!
This blade... cuts at a touch!
You can't read this blade's edge!
Heh, quite a keen edge.
Raaaah!!
Deeyaaah!!
Leap Slasher! Go!
Stealth Boomerang!
Not that I care for this kind of weapon!
Stake! Take this!
This is no ordinary Missile!
Its homing is top-notch!
This one's fast. Brace yourself!
By the time you notice, it's too late!
Now, I'll shoot you through!!
You're being targeted from the heavens...!
There's no escape, that's how it is!!
Taste this one's edge!
Gran Slash Ripper!
I know how to use this thing...!
Not yet!
Pierce through!!
Aschen, I'm using our trump card.
Quit posing, ex-Seaweed Brain.
Okay, here we go!
Can you see through this?!
Too slow!
Haaaah!
Hyaah!
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
Aschen Punch, rapid-fire, rapid-fire!
Time to finish you off!
Oh my! Striking!
It is not over yet!
This ends it!
Be blown away!!
There won't be a trace left.
Do your best~!
Never thought I'd have to do this!
Hear! My! Shooouuut!!
...Who decided I had to shout?
Looks like we've got customers~?
